decisions.reason: Limiting the colour versions to full-colour, black, and white does not cancel or alter the separately confirmed versions with and without the black box.

The client separately confirms that brand colour details remain included; limiting logo colour versions does not alter the current colour-code documentation requirement.
The selected set of logo colour versions does not alter the requirement to provide fully editable source files or their intended applications.
The source confirms rather than changes the separate requirement to provide font details for consistent brand use.
The number of final colour variants has no effect on the completed concept-development requirement or its originality constraints.
The source does not change the approved strapline lines or its graduated-colour treatment; it only limits the delivered colour-version set.
Selecting three standard colour variants does not change rev8-11 as the approved composition baseline.
The colour-version decision does not modify any approved letterform dimensions, features, or character treatments.
